meta_description: Oakley Plumbing and Heating Solutions in Derby. Emergency plumbing, boiler installation, and heating repairs. Fast response, Gas Safe registered. Call now.
hero_subhead: Frozen pipes, boiler breakdowns, or a slow leak? We're in your area within the hour, day or night.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full central heating installations, we handle every job with speed and precision.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast. We carry essential parts on every van and aim to get you back to normal the same day, any time of day or night.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: Modern, efficient boilers fitted and commissioned by Gas Safe engineers. New install comes with a full guarantee and a free annual service in year one.

services.title: Heating System Maintenance
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing, radiator bleeding, and system checks keep your heating running safely and cost-effectively through the winter months.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Full installation of taps, basins, and sink arrangements. We also handle supply pipework updates to feed new appliances or extensions.

services.title: Central Heating Repairs
services.desc: Cold radiators, noisy pumps, and loss of pressure diagnosed and remedied. Most faults cleared within 24 hours without needless parts replacement.

services.title: Power Flushing & System Upgrades
services.desc: Remove sludge and corrosion from old heating systems to restore efficiency. Ideal before a boiler replacement to protect your investment.

about_pullquote: We started Oakley because we were tired of watching neighbours ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Oakley Plumbing and Heating Solutions has been serving Derby and the surrounding areas for over 18 years. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted team of Gas Safe registered engineers, handling everything from midnight burst pipes to major boiler installations. We've built our reputation on honest pricing and turning up when we say we will.
about_para_2: Your home is your biggest investment, and we treat every job like it's our own. Repeat customers make up two-thirds of our work — people call us back because we listen to their concerns, explain options clearly, and never oversell. Whether it's an emergency or planned maintenance, you'll get a straightforward price and a tradesman who takes pride in the work.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Woken up at 2am by a burst pipe under the kitchen sink. Called Oakley and couldn't believe when someone answered. Rob was here before 3am with a van full of parts. Had it sorted, leak sealed, and even cleaned up the mess. What would have been a nightmare turned into just a minor inconvenience. Legend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation took a full day but Chris and his mate were professional and tidy throughout. They explained the new system, left clear instructions, and didn't push any extras we didn't need. First year service included, which was a nice touch. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Paula K.

reviews.text: Called about a cold radiator upstairs. Instead of just fixing it, Dave suggested a power flush to shift the muck in the whole system. Six months on and the heating is so much better and my bills are noticeably lower. Wish I'd done it sooner. Honest advice and fair pricing.
reviews.author: David H.
